<function name="ToHex" parent="Color" type="classfunc">
	<description>Converts a <page>Color</page> to its hexadecimal representation.
</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<added>2025.07.15</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="" type="boolean" default="false">Whether to forcibly omit the alpha channel from the output.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="string">The hexadecimal representation of the color. (`#RRGGBBAA`)

If the alpha channel is `255`, it will be omitted from the output (`#RRGGBB`)</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
